title: ship-ops-weekly-prep-notes
body:
Ship Ops Weekly — Release Train 12 (Friday sync prep)

Purpose: quick sync to validate go/no-go gates, surface blockers, confirm owners and communications for launch window. This is a scratchpad for talking points and follow-ups — keep short and actionable.

Meeting context: Friday 11:00-11:30 PT. Core attendees: release lead (Jonah), SRE (Aditi), eng on-call (Evan), product PM (Marta), QA lead (Priya - optional). Use #release-train for live notes.

Agenda (11:00 - 11:30)
- 11:00 - 11:03: Quick roll call + confirm attendee list
- 11:03 - 11:08: Current health snapshot (SRE) — latency, error rate, infra capacity
- 11:08 - 11:12: Feature readiness (eng leads) — big remaining items, PRs merging today
- 11:12 - 11:18: QA & canary status — regression windows, critical test pass/fail
- 11:18 - 11:23: Go/no-go checklist review — each gate owner calls OK/Blocker
- 11:23 - 11:28: Communications + rollout plan confirmation (who pings who, postmortem owner)
- 11:28 - 11:30: Action items and owners (capture in Jira)

Quick health bullets (prep items for SRE):
- Autoscaler status: predicted capacity for 10% traffic spike — Aditi to post metric snapshot in thread before sync (ETA: 10:30)
- GPU pool headroom: Dedicated pools show ~12% spare; check covariance with batch sizes (Evan)
- Recent flakiness: storage IOPS alerts (last 24h) — mitigated by temporary throttling, still watching

Feature readiness (eng notes):
- PRs to merge today: 
  - serving-runtime: PR#2543 (kernel selection fallback) — needs one final perf test (Evan)
  - console: rollout flags for canary routes — merged to staging, smoke passed (Marta)
- Model pinning: default release model pinned to v1.7.2; verify quantized artifact checksums (RLSD-4187)
- Unknown: small gating change in routing policy config — risk: may alter cold-start latency for new sessions

Go / No-Go checklist (owners call out explicitly) — annotate status pre-meeting with: OK / BLOCKER / WATCH
- Infra capacity validated (owner: Aditi) — status: WATCH (need metric snapshot)
- Critical PRs merged & smoke passed (owner: Evan) — status: BLOCKER (PR#2543 perf test pending)
- Canary traffic test (owner: Marta) — status: OK (staging canary passed, 1% canary planned)
- QA regression sweep clear on top-10 flows (owner: Priya) — status: OK (manual + e2e, flaky test still failing: auth-timeout-03)
- Rollback plan documented and tested (owner: Jonah) — status: OK (runbook v0.9, dry-run scheduled)
- Compliance & audit logs (owner: Security) — status: OK (log retention confirmed)

Immediate blockers / discussion points (to call out in sync)
- PR#2543 needs perf run under realistic sequence lengths; if it regresses p95 by >10% we need to revert the change — contingency: fallback to previous kernel selector (Evan)
- Auth-timeout-03 flaky test in QA pipeline — triage notes attached in RLSD-4123, root cause unknown; need SRE help to reproduce in staging
- Burst capacity billing anomaly in Dedicated pools; finance asked for a quick note in the launch comms if we hit thresholds

Action items (capture these on the meeting and create Jira tasks)
- Aditi: post autoscaler + GPU headroom snapshot to #release-train by 10:30 (due today 10:30)
- Evan: run perf sweep of PR#2543 across long-sequence workload, report p50/p95 by 10:45 (due today 10:45)
- Priya: re-run auth-timeout-03 with debug flags + attach logs to RLSD-4123 (due today 12:00)
- Jonah: verify rollback runbook steps & schedule dry-run with SRE (due today 16:00)
- Marta: confirm canary route config and message in #release-train for 1% rollout (due today 11:15)
- Security (cc: Nina): confirm KMS access audit log snapshot by EOD (due today 17:00)

Communication plan (short bullets)
- Pre-launch status: short update in #release-train at 11:35 summarizing gate statuses and action items (Jonah)
- Launch notification: 10-minute heads-up in #all when canary promotes to 10% (Marta to post)
- Post-launch incident channel: open incident thread under #incidents/launch-rt12 and assign SRE lead

Rollback / mitigation quick notes
- Trigger criteria: any service p95 > 2x baseline for >5min or error-rate >1% sustained 5min
- Immediate actions: throttle new session creation, promote previous model variant, scale-up fallback pool (runbook steps 3-6)
notes_to_self:
Keep this doc minimal — will copy actions into RLSD epic after meeting. If PR#2543 is blocked, prioritize a minimal revert path to avoid over-optimizing kernel selector right before launch.
Parking lot: follow up on cost-binning recommendations from Optimize team (defer until after launch).

Unresolved questions:
- Should we increase canary to 2% for an extra 30m to reduce risk? (Pros: catch more anomalies, Cons: increases blast radius) — quick poll in sync.
- Who will own the postmortem? default: Jonah but consider handing to product engineering manager if incident scope is product-facing.
